{"answer": "The checkout page already contains a working payment button that integrates with the existing checkout flow. Verified across the codebase:

- web/index.html defines <button id="pay-button" type="button" disabled>Pay now</button>, initially disabled until the service status loads.
- web/app.js enables the button after a successful GET /api/status, then on click POSTs the cart to /api/checkout with method "card", renders the returned status/amount/method into #result, handles errors, and re-enables the button in a finally block.
- checkout_app/server.py routes POST /api/checkout to create_checkout, which validates items and payment method and returns {status: "pending_payment", amount_cents, method}.
- checkout_app/checkout.py enforces positive quantities and supports "card" and "bank_transfer".

No code changes were required; the button satisfies the request...[+390 chars]
